calls.statement:
SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, s.store_id<900 AS is_store, COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) dist_line, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) dist_rl, SUM(f.net_amount) net, SUM(f.gross_amount) gross, SUM(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate)) calc_gross, SUM(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount - f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate))>0.02 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) mism, MIN(f.etl_loaded_at), MAX(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 THEN '999' WHEN s.store_id=900 THEN '900' ELSE 'store' END grp, p.category='ZZ Test' AS test, p.vat_class, f.vat_rate, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net, SUM(f.gross_amount) gross, SUM(CASE WHEN f.staff_purchase_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) staff, SUM(CASE WHEN f.net_amount<=0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nonpos
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30'
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4,5

WITH a AS (
 SELECT f.sale_date d, s.store_id, SUM(f.net_amount) net, COUNT(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) rc
 FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
 WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
 GROUP BY 1,2),
r AS (SELECT business_date d, store_id, net_sales_before_returns nb, receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE business_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND store_id<900)
SELECT strftime(COALESCE(a.d,r.d),'%Y-%m') m, COUNT(*) pairs, SUM(a.net) fact_net, SUM(r.nb) rpt_net, SUM(CASE WHEN a.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) only_rpt, SUM(CASE WHEN r.d IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) only_fact, SUM(CASE WHEN abs(coalesce(a.net,0)-coalesce(r.nb,0))>0.05 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) diffs, SUM(CASE WHEN a.rc<>r.receipts THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) rcdiff
FROM a FULL JOIN r ON a.d=r.d AND a.store_id=r.store_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date, f.vat_rate, COUNT(*) n, SUM(f.net_amount) net, SUM(f.gross_amount) gross, SUM(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount-round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2))>0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-29' AND DATE '2024-09-03' AND s.store_id<900 AND f.vat_rate>0.2
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT strftime(f.sale_date,'%Y-%m') m, COUNT(*) n, SUM(CASE WHEN abs(f.gross_amount-round(f.net_amount*(1+f.vat_rate),2))>0.011 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) bad, SUM(CASE WHEN f.gross_amount IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) nullgross, SUM(f.gross_amount) gross
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2024-08-01' AND DATE '2024-09-30' AND s.store_id<900 AND s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
